description: Table 3 of Bregere & Bessa (2020) under the Calinski-Harabasz definition identified in phase-3 verification (spec section 7), with eqs. 3-5 as printed and sklearn's score for contrast.

definitions.S_identified: (|I|-k)/(k-1) * sum_l |C_l| ||Y(C_l)-Y(I)|| / sum_l (1/|C_l|) sum_{i in C_l} ||Y(i)-Y(C_l)||  (Euclidean norms, NOT squared; |C_l|-weighted between term)
definitions.S_eq345_printed: (|I|-k) sum_l ||Y(C_l)-Y(I)||^2 / ((k-1) sum_l (1/|C_l|) sum_{i in C_l} ||Y(i)-Y(C_l)||^2)  (the paper's eqs. 3-5 as printed)
definitions.CH_sklearn: sklearn.metrics.calinski_harabasz_score(Y, labels) = (|I|-k) sum_l |C_l| ||Y(C_l)-Y(I)||^2 / ((k-1) sum_i ||Y(i)-Y(C_l(i))||^2); evaluated from the shared sufficient statistics; sklearn's function itself is called on every single clustering and on the first 3 random seeds of each group and series and must agree to 1e-8 (self_checks)
definitions.computation: cluster means by a one-hot matrix product; squared distances to the own centroid by ||Y(i)||^2 - 2 Y(i).Y(C_l) + ||Y(C_l)||^2; one literal cluster-by-cluster recomputation of S_identified per group (self_checks)
definitions.Y(I), Y(C_l): mean record vector of all households / of cluster C_l
definitions.random_labels_sd: population SD over the 20 seeds (numpy std, ddof = 0), as in clustering_results.json and the verifier
definitions.null_approx_S_identified: random-label approximation (n-k)/(k-1) * sqrt(n(k-1))/k * rho, rho = RMS / mean of ||Y(i)-Y(I)||; grows like sqrt(n)

series.raw: the household's 17,520 filled half-hourly records of 2013 (kWh), data/lcl2013_kwh_filled.npy, the authors' slot convention
series.std: raw / the household's mean over the 17,520 records ('standardized')
series.special: the std records at the Low-or-High slots of the special mask only ('special tariff - standardized'); Std households get the same (placebo) mask
